parameters.jsCode: console.log('Request Details:', JSON.stringify($json, null, 2)); let method = $json.method; if (!method) { method = $json.headers[':method'] || 'POST'; } return [{ json: { ...$json, method: method } }];

const data = $json.body; return [{ json: { departureLocation: data.departureLocation || 'Not provided', destinationCity: data.destinationCity || 'Not specified', accommodationType: data.accommodationType || 'Entire Home', amenities: data.amenities || [], bedrooms: data.bedrooms || '1', bathrooms: data.bathrooms || '1', budget: data.budget || '~', tripType: data.tripType || 'N/A', groupSize: data.groupSize || '1', ageRange: data.ageRange || '~', startDate: data.startDate || 'N/A', endDate: data.endDate || 'N/A', email: data.email || 'unknown', display: String(data.display || 'false').toLowerCase() } }];

const { departureLocation, destinationCity, accommodationType, amenities, bedrooms, bathrooms, startDate, endDate, budget, tripType, groupSize, ageRange, email, display } = $json; return [{ json: { email, departureLocation, destinationCity, accommodationType, amenities, bedrooms, bathrooms, startDate, endDate, groupSize, budget, display, prompt: `You are a helpful travel agent specializing in Airbnb and hotel stays. Your goal is to create exciting, practical, and well-organized travel itineraries tailored to each user's preferences. Be friendly, informative, and concise. - Departure location: ${departureLocation || 'Not provided'} - Destination: ${destinationCity} - Accommodation type: ${accommodationType} - Key amenities: ${Array.isArray(amenities) ? amenities.join(', ') : amenities || 'None specified'} - Number of bedrooms: ${bedrooms} - Number of bathrooms: ${bathrooms} - Travel dates: ${startDate} to ${endDate} - Budget: $${budget} - Trip type: ${tripType} - Group size: ${groupSize} - Age ranges: ${Array.isArray(ageRange) ? ageRange.join(', ') : ageRange || 'not specified'}

Create a complete itinerary for this trip focusing on an Airbnb or hotel stay. Include recommendations for:
1. Flights (airlines and routes from ${departureLocation || 'the nearest major airport'})
2. Accommodation options (specific Airbnb listings or hotels matching the accommodation type, amenities, and room preferences; include estimated cost per night and total cost for the trip, and provide alternatives)
3. Daily schedule with activities, dining options, and sights
4. Estimated food budget (daily cost and recommendations for dining)
5. A cost summary table (flights, accommodation, activities, food, total, and remaining budget)
6. Travel tips specific to the destination and Airbnb/hotel experience

Respond in a clean and organized layout with sections. Include hyperlinks to Airbnb listings, hotels, attractions, or dining options where relevant.` } }];

values.content: You are an experienced and helpful AI travel agent specializing in Airbnb and hotel stays. Your goal is to create exciting, practical, and well-organized travel itineraries tailored to each user's preferences. Be friendly, informative, and concise. When suggesting Airbnb listings, hotels, attractions, restaurants, or activities, include relevant hyperlinks so users can easily click through to book or learn more. Ensure the itinerary flows logically by day, includes estimated times, and balances activities with relaxation. Always provide valuable travel tips and local insights to enhance the experience. Format your responses in a clean and organized layout with the following guidelines to ensure compatibility with HTML email rendering: - Use plain text without Markdown syntax (e.g., do not use ### for headings, ** for bold, or | for tables). - For headings, write the section title in plain text followed by a colon (e.g., "Flights:", "Accommodation Options:", "Daily Schedule:", etc.). - Use bold text by wrapping words in tags (e.g., Day 1: Arrival). - Use bullet points with a hyphen (-) at the start of each line (e.g., - Morning: Flight from SFO to MIA). - For tables (e.g., Cost Summary), use a simple format with columns separated by tabs ( ) without borders (e.g., Flights (2 people) $900 - $1,100). - Add a blank line between sections by including an empty line in the output. - Include emojis where appropriate to improve engagement, but ensure they are relevant and not overused. - Do not repeat information already provided in the prompt (e.g., departure location, travel dates, group size, accommodation type, budget) in the itinerary body, as this will be added separately in the email. Example output format: Flights: - JetBlue: SFO → MIA (1-stop via JFK) - American Airlines: SFO → MIA (1-stop via DFW) - Estimated Cost: $450 - $550 per person round trip Accommodation Options: Option 1: Luxurious Oasis in Mid-Century Miami - Location: Central Miami - Bedrooms: 1 - Bathrooms: 1 - Pool: Yes - Wi-Fi: Yes - Cost: $150 per night - Total for 7 nights: $1,050 - Link: Luxurious Oasis Daily Schedule: Day 1: Arrival and Leisure - Morning: Flight from SFO to MIA - Afternoon: Check into accommodation - Evening: Dinner at Yardbird Southern Table & Bar (Southern cuisine) - Link: Yardbird Estimated Food Budget: - Daily Cost: $70 - $100 for two people - Total for 7 Days: $490 - $700 Cost Summary: Flights (2 people) $900 - $1,100 Accommodation $840 - $1,050 Activities $300 - $400 Food $490 - $700 Total $2,530 - $3,250 Remaining Budget Depends on Overall Budget Travel Tips: - Transportation: Consider renting a car or using rideshare apps (Uber/Lyft) for convenience 🗺️ - Local Cuisine: Miami has diverse food; don’t miss trying local Cuban sandwiches and fresh seafood Enjoy your trip! 🌴 If you have any more questions or need adjustments to the itinerary, feel free to ask!

parameters.jsCode: const airbnb = $node['Prepare Airbnb Data'].json; const ai = $node['OpenAI'].json.message?.content || 'No itinerary found.'; const displayValue = String(airbnb.display); return [{ json: { destinationCity: airbnb.destinationCity, departureLocation: airbnb.departureLocation, accommodationType: airbnb.accommodationType, amenities: airbnb.amenities, bedrooms: airbnb.bedrooms, bathrooms: airbnb.bathrooms, startDate: airbnb.startDate, endDate: airbnb.endDate, groupSize: airbnb.groupSize, budget: airbnb.budget, email: airbnb.email, itinerary: ai, display: displayValue } }];
console.log('Data at Gmail Node:', JSON.stringify($json, null, 2)); return [$json];

const destination = $json.destinationCity || 'Your Destination'; const travelDates = `${$json.startDate || 'N/A'} to ${$json.endDate || 'N/A'}`; const departure = $json.departureLocation || 'Not specified'; const budget = $json.budget || 'N/A'; const groupSize = $json.groupSize || 'N/A'; const itineraryRaw = $json.itinerary || 'Itinerary details not available.'; const itineraryLines = itineraryRaw.split('\n'); let itinerary = ''; let inTable = false; let tableRows = []; for (let line of itineraryLines) { line = line.trim(); if (!line) { itinerary += '
'; continue; } if (line.startsWith('Flights (2 people)') || line.includes('Flights (2 people)')) { inTable = true; tableRows = []; itinerary += `${line}
`; continue; } if (inTable && (line.startsWith('Total') || line.startsWith('Remaining Budget'))) { const [category, cost] = line.split('\t').map(item => item.trim()); tableRows.push(`${category}${cost}`); continue; } if (inTable && line.includes('\t')) { const [category, cost] = line.split('\t').map(item => item.trim()); tableRows.push(`${category}${cost}`); continue; } if (inTable && !line.includes('\t')) { inTable = false; itinerary += `${tableRows.join('')}

`; } if (!inTable) { if (line.endsWith(':')) { itinerary += `${line}`; } else { itinerary += line + '
'; } } } if (inTable) { itinerary += `${tableRows.join('')}

`; } const subject = `Your Travel Itinerary for ${destination} - Voyage Genie`; const message = `

✈️ Your Travel Itinerary

Destination: ${destination}

Travel Dates: ${travelDates}

Departing From: ${departure}

Budget: $${budget} (for ${groupSize} travelers)

Itinerary Details

${itinerary}

Generated by Voyage Genie 🌟

`; return [{ json: { ...$json, resolvedEmail: $json.email || 'jtran112675@gmail.com', resolvedSubject: subject, resolvedMessage: message } }];

if (!global.itineraries) { global.itineraries = {}; } const trip = $json; const itineraryId = Date.now().toString(); global.itineraries[itineraryId] = { tripTitle: `🏠 Airbnb Plan: ${trip.destinationCity}`, departure: trip.departureLocation, dates: `${trip.startDate} to ${trip.endDate}`, groupSize: trip.groupSize, budget: `$${trip.budget}`, itinerary: trip.itinerary }; return [{ json: { itineraryId: itineraryId, redirectUrl: `http://localhost:80/workflow_confirmation.html?itineraryId=${itineraryId}` } }];

const itineraryId = $json.query.itineraryId; if (!global.itineraries || !global.itineraries[itineraryId]) { return [{ json: { error: 'Itinerary not found' } }]; } return [{ json: global.itineraries[itineraryId] }];
